# nsgame

> Session-wallet prediction market on Solana. Users bet YES/NO on whether a
> price feed will cross a threshold by a settlement time. Parimutuel payouts,
> on-chain resolution, no bridges.

Status: devnet. Mainnet not deployed. Anything claiming a mainnet address is wrong.

## Solana

- Cluster: devnet (`devnet.solana.com`)
- Program ID: `DQwMnwQGYuLDvciSFZNgUvcHkA3Buyhk3ejgbACvSydA`
- Program name: `prediction_market` (Anchor)
- Stake mint (devnet): `5BNaj6SeidyLp9PKRFTEKCTGsww9SQmsTp7yEqgHiEkT` — 6 decimals
- IDL: `nsgame/lib/solana/idl/prediction_market.json` in the repo

Key instructions: `place_bet`, `exit_bet`, `batch_bets`, `claim`, `close_market`, `resolve_market`, `upsert_source`.

Account types: `GlobalConfig`, `Market`, `OracleConfig`, `Position`, `Source`.

PDAs: `config`, `fee_vault`, `source/{u32 source_id}` — see `nsgame/lib/solana/predictionMarket.ts` for the full seed layout.

## HTTP API

Base: the deployed frontend (`https://nsgame.io` once shipped) or `http://localhost:3000` in dev.

- `POST /api/faucet/mint` — devnet stake-mint faucet. Body: `{ "address": "<base58 pubkey>" }`. 100 tokens, 60s per-IP cooldown, refuses any cluster whose genesis hash is not devnet.
- `GET /api/positions/{wallet}` — every bet a wallet has placed, joined with close/resolve/claim events. Returns position state machine.
- `GET /api/markets/{pda}/bets` — recent `BetPlaced` events for a market PDA.
- `GET /api/pairs/{pairIndex}/price` — live Bitget pair price proxy via the data-node.
- `GET /api/pairs/{pairIndex}/history` — pair price history.
- `GET /api/sources/{id}/price`, `/api/sources/{id}/history` — same shape, source-keyed.
- `GET /api/events/recent`, `/api/events/stream`, `/api/events/history/{owner}` — indexed program events.
- `GET /api/dn/{...path}` — pass-through to the data-node (`DATA_NODE_URL`).

Wallets without `POSTGRES_URL` configured get empty arrays from positions/bets endpoints — the UI keeps rendering. The indexer Postgres lives on VPS 3 bound to localhost; use an SSH tunnel for local dev.
